notes.title: HYPER DEMON PVP
notes.content:
Find the secret bird to access [i][b]HYPER DEMON PVP[/b][/i].

Join the global queue to 1v1 other HYPER DEMON players.

[h3]PVP Queue:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The first two players in the queue fight and the winner plays on. 
[*] The rest of the queue spectates.
[*] Enable "quickplay" to challenge other players waiting in the queue and the winner will take the higher place in the queue.
[/list]

[h3]Controls:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tap LMB to fire a hitscan weapon.
[*] Hold RMB to activate shield.
[*] Hold LMB with full ammo for charge projectile.
[*] Hold LMB with a single shot left to fire a piercing hitscan (ignores enemy shield but destroys your own).
[*] Use arrow keys to cycle through spectate views, or click the eye under the players name to watch from first-person perspective.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage the other player to grow their weak point.
[*] Hit the red weak point to defeat them instantly.
[*] First to 3 points wins the match.
[*] Shield will shrink while active or when damaged.
[*] Shield will only recharge after being destroyed.
[*] Activating shield during recharge will end the recharge.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42972331/a17f8cb53157d867d299f214c7ea81188ce91dfb.png[/img]
Thanks for your support over the last 2 years!

notes.title: Patch notes November 2023
notes.content:
[b]ENEMY1 / SPAWNER + SKULLS[/b]
[list]
[*] small skulls move slower
[*] delay skulls spawning after teleport
[*] fix skulls sometimes killing player when stomping spawner
[*] don't allow rail lock-on during spawner teleport
[/list]

[b]ENEMY 2 / SCUTTLER[/b]
[list]
[*] allow slide without cancelling scuttler gem dash combo
[*] fix direct bomb hits sometimes not killing scuttlers
[*] fix bug where falling scuttler can still kill you when you're airborn/sliding
[/list]

[b]ENEMY3 / SERPENT / SNAKE[/b]
[list]
[*] snake stomp consistency improvements
[*] snake hp tweak
[*] reduce delay on snake attack after spawn
[*] 1 fewer segment of snake tail is collidable
[*] snake will turn toward you if you get close to its tail
[/list]

[b]GRAB / THROW[/b]
[list]
[*] fix held items moving out of hand when changing direction rapidly
[*] fix bombs exploding immediately after throw if thrown too horizontally
[*] allow immediate bomb re-grab after bounce
[*] gems can be grabbed with LMB while holding RMB, even if no gems held yet
[/list]

[b]PROGRESSION[/b]
[list]
[*] fix centipede delaying spawns when killing two enemies at the same time
[*] fix boss spawn not advancing if killing two enemies at the same time
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes January 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed enemies sometimes [url=https://hyprd.mn/clip/989044586]teleporting [/url]a short distance when materializing.

notes.title: Tweaks and bug fixes.
notes.content:
[h3]Tweaks for new players[/h3]
-Score will always reset above 0 when score is added.
-ENEMY 1 spawns 10 small skulls instead of 15
-Powerups won't spawn as early for new players

[h3]Balance/Tweaks[/h3]
-Shooting daggers down no longer slows fall from a regular jump.

-Added a short window after touching the ground where ENEMY 2 landing on top of the player will still kill the enemy instead of the player.
-ENEMY 2 will no longer avoid daggers when on the ground.

-Added a short delay where newly spawned gems won't be collected as dagger ammo to allow time to press RMB to grab as laser ammo.
-Tweaked ENEMY 4 hitbox when dropped to prevent accidentally grabbing objects on the other side of the enemy.
-Tweaked spawn position of gems when ENEMY 4 is dropped.

-Pressing restart or escape will skip to the end of the leaderboard climb animation.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
-FOV no longer clamps to 120 when launching the game.
-Fixed replays showing double laser ammo around wrist.
-Fixed powerup timing when playing offline.
-Fixed dagger unlock animations not playing
